text:
https://getlibrium.app/

I’m working on a document library app for macOS with tagging, collections and user attributes. Unlike other apps that pull files into their own databases or reorganize files into their own folders, Librium indexes files in place, so your existing folder structure stays in tact. It works with folders on your local drive in addition to external and network drives and the cloud. Search works with on-device text extraction and OCR.

It’s currently in Test Flight beta, but I’m planning to have it to App Review this week.
